1.content:
| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| Statement | Bristlecone shall provide the Services described in this SOW in accordance with the governing MSA between METRO and Bristlecone Incorporated. |
| Scope Description | Services cover implementation of SAP Cloud ALM for METRO to support Technical Monitoring and Change Request Management aligned to the S/4 RISE migration plan from January 2026 through October 2026. In scope are onboarding and configuration of the SAP Cloud ALM tenant subaccount; SAP Cloud ALM Standard Change Management and ChaRM; Change & Deployment Management; SAP Landscape Management and data flow configuration to Cloud ALM; monitoring for SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP applications, MII, Datasphere and Ariba where connected to the agreed Cloud ALM use cases; System Health Monitoring, Application Monitoring, Job Monitoring, User Performance Monitoring in S/4HANA, and Integration Monitoring for S/4 and Integration Suite/CPI; notification and alert management; user management within the SAP Cloud ALM tenant; standard health and change management dashboards; production integration in ChaRM and operations use cases; train-the-trainer workshop; SOP for end users; issue resolution during hypercare; document updates; and support transition to the METRO team. Scope is limited to the agreed METRO landscape, monitoring use cases, transport governance model, and transport sequence DEV → QA → PROD. |
| Sites / Environments | Sandbox, Development, Quality, and Production environments as referenced in the implementation timeline. |
| Key Integrations / Data Flows | Data flow from agreed SAP systems to SAP Cloud ALM; integration monitoring for S/4 and Integration Suite/CPI; transport route and release strategy configuration for DEV, QA, and Production within the agreed ChaRM scope. |

1.3.content:
- METRO will maintain an active SAP Cloud ALM subscription for the full January 2026 to October 2026 delivery period.
- METRO will provide timely onboarding access for the technical team to the SAP Cloud ALM tenant, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP applications, MII, and agreed Integration Suite/CPI-connected systems.
- METRO will finalize monitoring use cases, metric values, and the Cloud ALM user/role matrix by May 2026.
- METRO and Bristlecone will align on the target transport governance model and DEV → QA → PROD transport sequence before ChaRM configuration begins.
- Prerequisite configurations required for monitoring and data flow readiness will be completed by June 2026.
- METRO will provide named participants for train-the-trainer, authorization testing, cutover readiness, and transition activities in line with the project timeline.
- Successful go-live readiness of the agreed landscapes will be available before Production deployment in September 2026.
- If any assumption does not hold, the Change Request process in section 5 applies and project cost or timeline may be revised.

1.4.content:
- Business Process Monitoring, Configuration & Security Analysis, Intelligent Event Processing, Quality Gate Management, Test Management, and other SAP Cloud ALM capabilities not expressly listed as in scope are not included.
- No migration of historical content, schemas, PPFs, or custom Solution Manager 7.2 configurations to SAP Cloud ALM will be provided.
- No development of custom SAP Cloud ALM features, custom applications, or non-standard extensions beyond standard configuration for the agreed use cases will be provided.
- No support for systems, interfaces, or METRO applications outside the agreed SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP, MII, Datasphere, Ariba, and Integration Suite/CPI landscape is included.
- No infrastructure hosting, SAP licensing, SAP subscription procurement, or third-party software procurement is included.
- No ongoing managed services, 24x7 operations support, or post-hypercare production support beyond October 2026 is included.
- No end-user training beyond the agreed train-the-trainer workshop and SOP for end users will be provided.
- No work on requirements, deliverables, environments, integrations, reports, or support activities not expressly stated as in scope is included and will require a change request.

2.1.content:

- Such work will be charged on a Time & Materials basis at the agreed role rates, plus any approved shift allowance or other agreed premium charges stated in this SOW, and invoiced monthly in arrears against client-approved timesheets.
- Where out-of-hours support is needed for deployment, cutover, testing, or hypercare activities, the parties will plan those windows in advance through the project governance process.

2.2.content:

- The anticipated delivery split is approximately 80% Offshore and 20% Onsite/remote sessions with METRO, subject to project phase needs and any mutually agreed changes through the Change Request process.
- Travel, lodging, and related onsite expenses, where pre-approved by METRO, will be handled in accordance with the Travel & Expenses section of this SOW.

5.content:
Any change to the scope, deliverables, assumptions, timeline, environments, integrations, resource profile, service location split, working hours, or the not-to-exceed ceiling must be handled through a written Change Request.

Each Change Request must describe the requested change, the reason for the change, and the affected SOW section(s). Bristlecone will document the delivery impact assessment and METRO will support confirmation of business and landscape dependencies. Every Change Request must include both commercial impact and timeline impact, stated quantitatively even where the impact is zero.

No work for a proposed change will begin until the Change Request is approved and signed by both parties. Work performed without an approved and signed Change Request is not chargeable, does not increase the not-to-exceed ceiling, and does not justify moving any agreed milestone, target date, or review window.

For this Time & Materials engagement, approved Change Requests may revise scope, roles, effort estimates, service location mix, working-hour coverage, travel assumptions, the not-to-exceed ceiling, milestone dates, or other affected SOW terms. Payment for approved Services remains based on actual effort expended at the agreed role rates, invoiced monthly in arrears against METRO-approved timesheets. Deliverable acceptance continues to govern quality and rework only and does not trigger payment.

A Change Request will follow this workflow:

| Step | Activity | Owner | Turnaround |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Raise the Change Request with a clear description of the proposed change and affected SOW terms. | Either party | 2 Business Days from identification of the change |
| 2 | Log the Change Request and assign a reference number. | Bristlecone Project Manager | 1 Business Day from receipt |
| 3 | Assess scope, resource, commercial, and timeline impact, including quantified nil impact where applicable. | Bristlecone Project Manager with Cloud ALM Architect and METRO Primary Client Contact / METRO Single POC for ChaRM Input, as applicable | 5 Business Days from logging |
| 4 | Review the assessment and confirm whether the Change Request is accepted, rejected, or returned for clarification. | METRO Primary Client Contact and Bristlecone engagement lead | 3 Business Days from impact assessment submission |
| 5 | Prepare and circulate the amendment or Change Request form for signature where approved. | Bristlecone Project Manager | 2 Business Days from approval decision |
| 6 | Sign the approved Change Request; only after both signatures are received does the change take effect. Final approval authority rests with METRO’s authorized project lead and Bristlecone’s authorized signatory. | Authorized signatories of both parties | 5 Business Days from circulation |

If a Change Request is rejected or not signed by both parties, Bristlecone will continue to perform only the then-current agreed scope under this SOW. Pending review of a Change Request does not relieve either party of its obligations for already-approved Services and deliverables.
